title: Exceptional-point braiding with native controls
summary: Exceptional points define branch-exchange state transfers through holomorphic continuation of non-Hermitian eigenmodes, but realizing these transfers dynamically remains difficult. Slow encircling does not generally transport the full set of instantaneous eigenstates, while shortcuts to adiabaticity can require controls outside the native experimental manifold. Here, we introduce a constrained shortcut-to-adiabaticity principle for exceptional-point braiding using native controls.
